title: Save and reuse native A/B baselines

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** Maintained proof caught one plausible fault in `SEED-346#reuse-native-comparison-baselines`, sourced from `.planning/seeds/SEED-346-native-ab-comparisons.md#reuse-native-comparison-baselines`, at implementation revision `9a6ee910c9b2ffa0cbc7e5736739867843ce7bcd`.

The selected promise is that a material reader change obtains fresh baseline evidence when retained scalar metrics and stream hashes cannot replay the original inputs. In an isolated detached scratch checkout at that revision, the sole production mutation added `native-host-stream-adapters.mjs` to `derivedReaders` in `Distribution/tests/support/native-comparison-baseline-applicability.mjs:54`. That incorrectly treats the stream reader as replayable derived assessment. Fixtures and assertions remained unchanged.

The focused command was `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH caffeinate -s -i bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/tests/native-comparison-baseline-readers.sh`. Its unmodified baseline passed, exercising the supported comparison entry for both maintained reader-change cases. With the fault, the same command exited 1 at `Distribution/tests/native-comparison-baseline-readers.sh:27`, whose session-count assertion requires two newly observed host sessions. It reported: `FAIL: changed native-host-stream-adapters.mjs started 1 sessions, expected two fresh arms`. Later record-label assertions were not the catch.

An independent scratch exercise used the unchanged `native-comparison-pair-fixture.sh` and supported maintainer entry: capture the quiet substitute baseline, change and commit the real manifest-listed stream reader, then compare with `--reuse-baseline` pointing to the saved archive. The reader SHA-256 changed from `4936d8da3f4cd5a90636223d98e70dd6c130dbe53b14a8be7f1e6d7a15131389` to `8c21c4e396255b709ffbe7acaa790b9cd49891aa6f2ff0effdab0ff6854e8b81`. Actual substitute host root-session files increased from 1 to 2, establishing only one new launch. The new session's applied workspace was under `/candidate/`; no new baseline session appeared. The entry reported `baseline-acquisition: reused`, cited the original archive, and reported `observed-arms: historical baseline; candidate session only`. This establishes the wrong acquisition behavior, beyond merely reaching the fault. The original archive's digest stayed identical.

Restoration copied back the exact original production bytes under an interruption-safe trap. The scratch status matched its clean pre-probe state, `git diff --exit-code` passed, and the same focused command passed after restoration. A final comparison against the selected revision was clean. The owned scratch checkout, its worktree registration, independent witness fixture and temporary artifacts were removed. The parent checkout was never edited. No paid native session or network publication ran. AC power was confirmed; focused checks are independent of full-suite admission and ran under the maintained macOS sleep guard.

**Next proof action:** retain the existing entry-level reader-change journey as the regression gate for this promise; this probe supports no additional assertion or missing-path repair. Its evidence is limited to the observed stream-reader path.

**Prior disposition:** this matches the already-repaired G2 obligation in `.planning/slice-plans/622-save-and-reuse-native-ab-baselines/PLAN.md`; recognizing that repair is separate from making a new repair decision.

- **Test runtime.** Measured runner durations: faulted focused run 17.6 seconds; restored focused run 28.4 seconds. The initial passing run's duration is unavailable because its default temporary timing file was removed; the independent witness was not separately timed. No total test-runtime figure is claimed.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no separate human-time measurement was supplied or observed.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable: no separate agent-token or active-agent-time measurement was exposed. Invocation elapsed is reported separately below.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 217530 ms (measured), from 1794678472000 to 1794678689530 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked implementation: `9a6ee910c9b2ffa0cbc7e5736739867843ce7bcd`. Later execution-complete and closure edits change records only; the checked acquisition path and maintained assertion remain unchanged. The deliberate scratch fault is not a delivered defect. Retain `Distribution/tests/native-comparison-baseline-readers.sh` as the existing regression gate. No actionable assertion gap or missing path was reported, so no new correction or queue change is required. Existing G2 was already repaired and proved; this check confirms that one protection, without claiming whole-story mutation coverage. Scratch restoration and removal are verified by the worker report.
